verdict.rationale: The docs show Conductor automatically creates a branch and worktree for each workspace. They also say it helps you review the diff and open a pull request when work is ready. Nothing in the pack shows the agent staging changes or writing commit messages, and it is unclear whether the agent or the user opens the PR. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-driven staging and commit-message generation, detail on how PR creation works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
